name: @wae/open-finder-workspace
description: OpenFinder workspace: Rust crates, npm application packages, CLI, skills, and VMZ UI

scripts.build: pnpm run build:napi && pnpm run build:ts && pnpm run build:ui
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace
scripts.gui: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @wae/open-finder exec node ./dist/cli.js gui
